# TheNovaNodes MCP Router

> High-performance Model Context Protocol (MCP) gateway, router, and security multiplexer written in Pure Go.

The MCP Router serves as the central nervous system and tool multiplexer for autonomous agents, routing tool invocations across multiple downstream MCP servers (stdio, SSE, HTTP) with session-scoped access control, rate limiting, and security guardrails.

## Architecture & Documents
- [Architecture](ARCHITECTURE.md): Multi-tenant MCP multiplexer, session isolation, protocol bridging, and routing pipelines.
- [Agents Contract](AGENTS.md): Core invariants, Golden Loop verification commands, zero-panic policy, and branch guards.
- [Security Policy](SECURITY.md): Threat model, responsible disclosure, token validation, and guardrails.
- [Contributing Guide](CONTRIBUTING.md): Git Flow rules, pre-commit checks, and PR lifecycle.

## Core Implementation Files
- `main.go`: Entry point, lifecycle management, graceful shutdown, and CLI flags.
- `router.go`: Dynamic tool dispatch, prefix routing, allowlist enforcement, and agent authorization.
- `multiplexer.go`: Downstream MCP server lifecycle management, stdio/SSE transports, and health checks.
- `auth.go`: Bearer token validation, local peer resolution, and session management.
- `config.go`: YAML configuration loader, environment substitution, and schema validation.
- `health.go`: Liveness and readiness endpoints, backend ping, and diagnostic telemetry.
- `logger.go`: Structured JSON logging and audit failsafe mechanisms.

## Key APIs & Endpoints
- `POST /mcp`: Primary JSON-RPC 2.0 MCP routing endpoint.
- `GET /health`: Router liveness probe.
- `GET /ready`: Router readiness probe with upstream backend verification.
